title: Ukrainian Oat Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting casserole made with oats, inspired by Ukrainian cuisine.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked vegetables, oats, beef broth, and sour cream. Mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
If using, sprinkle chopped fresh dill on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the casserole is lightly browned on top.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
